The merge of this branch into agentteam/run-... remains a Lead/gate action and is correctly out of the author's scope. One cross-item observation, not a defect in A: B's file (src/b.txt) ends with a newline while A's does not; DoD does not specify newline convention, so this does not block.

findings.suggestion: Either accept both conventions as-is (DoD is satisfied), or have the Lead state a newline convention for future file items; do not block merge on this.
